ops.current_summary: Environmental awareness only — not doctrinal. REGULATION (most material this week): EU AI Act Digital Omnibus has firmed since the 7 May provisional deal — the European Parliament adoption vote is now expected around 7 July 2026 (ahead of the original 2 Aug trigger). The package introduces two NEW prohibited practices — using AI to generate or manipulate non-consensual intimate imagery (NCII) and CSAM — with that prohibition dated 2 Dec 2026; high-risk Annex III standalone AI is pushed to 2 Dec 2027 and embedded high-risk (Annex I) to 2 Aug 2028. The NCII/CSAM prohibition is adjacent to SageReasoning's intimate-data posture (R17). AUSTRALIA: the first mandatory requirement under the 'Policy for the responsible use of AI in government' begins 15 June 2026 — now ~2 weeks out. Clarification from this week's scan: it binds Australian Public Service agencies (mandatory foundational AI training for all staff, an AI-incident process, and a public/staff reporting pathway), NOT private companies directly — so SageReasoning is not bound by it, but it signals the AU compliance direction. SOLO-FOUNDER + SMB: carried forward — Claude for Small Business (13 May; 15 agentic workflows + connectors via Cowork) and the solo-founder economics (~36.3% of new US companies solo-founded by mid-2025; full agent stack ~$3K–$12K/year) are unchanged. FUNDING: Carta State of Pre-Seed Q1 2026 unchanged — AI ~50% of pre-seed dollars, ~33% of total VC, ~42% AI seed valuation premium (median pre-money ~$17.9M); barbell market ($1M–$2.5M band down to 18%). A quiet week on net-new funding/automation items. RISKS — FOUNDER ATTENTION: AU 15 June proximity (signal, not obligation); watch Omnibus 7 July vote. OPPORTUNITY: Claude for Small Business stack remains a near-zero-marginal-cost lift for the founder's own Sage Ops tooling.

tech.current_summary: Environmental awareness only — not doctrinal. ANTHROPIC — HEADLINE: Claude Opus 4.8 shipped 28 May 2026. It took #1 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (61.4) and posts SWE-bench Verified 88.6% (up from 87.6% on 4.7) and SWE-bench Pro 69.2%. Pricing is UNCHANGED at $5/$25 per million tokens; a new optional 'fast mode' runs ~2.5x faster at $10/$50. The release emphasises honesty/reliability: Anthropic reports Opus 4.8 is ~4x less likely than 4.7 to let flaws in its own code pass unflagged and produces dishonest summaries of agentic work ~17x less often than Sonnet 4.6 — an honesty emphasis that is incidentally congruent with SageReasoning's honest-positioning posture and directly relevant to the founder's build/dogfood stack. This also resolves the prior 'Sonnet 4.8' rumour — the model that shipped was Opus 4.8, not a Sonnet. Alongside: dynamic workflows (orchestrate tens-to-hundreds of background agents) in Claude Code, effort control in claude.ai, and Managed Agents can now self-host sandboxes (tool execution in your environment, agent loop on Anthropic infra) — relevant to any future Sage Ops build. SUPABASE: pricing unchanged; ACTION ITEM — Postgres 14 is deprecated as of 1 July 2026, and projects still on it will be auto-upgraded to the latest Postgres on that date (confirm SageReasoning's instance version before then). Stripe Sync Engine still relevant to P4. SECURITY: new this week — 'NGINX Rift' CVE-2026-42945 (heap overflow in ngx_http_rewrite_module, latent since 2008; landed 13 May) and Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN CVE-2026-20182 (CVSS 10.0 auth bypass); cPanel CVE-2026-41940 still mass-exploited. None of these directly hits a Vercel + Supabase stack, but verify Next.js is on 15.5.18 / 16.2.6. RISKS — FOUNDER ATTENTION: Supabase Postgres 14 auto-upgrade 1 July; confirm Next.js patched. OPPORTUNITY: Opus 4.8's honesty gains + self-hosted sandboxes.

support.current_summary: Environmental awareness only — not doctrinal. MENTAL-HEALTH AI REGULATION: New York's AI-companion safeguards law is now IN EFFECT — operators must disclose the user is interacting with AI (not a human) and must detect indicators of self-harm and refer the user to crisis hotlines/interventions. It remains the de-facto R20a design template, now with live-law force rather than pending status. State momentum is escalating sharply: ~43 states have introduced 240+ chatbot bills in 2026 (vs the prior scan's read of 36 states / 70+ in Q1) — most centred on AI-disclosure mandates; Illinois and Nevada still ban AI for behavioural health; the federal SAFE BOTs Act continues to mandate crisis-resource referral and bar chatbots presenting as licensed professionals. The compliance floor SageReasoning's human-facing tools will sit on is rising. SAFETY INCIDENTS — fresh: OECD.AI logged an incident (19 May 2026) on AI-companion 'romances' undermining real-life relationships among young adults (secrecy, relationship strain, emotional harm); Stanford (April 2026) reported AI-relationship 'delusional spirals.' Both are adjacent to R19 (mirror principle) and R20 (relationship asymmetry, independence encouragement) and reinforce the synchronous distress-classifier discipline (PR3) — anything touching crisis needs safety-by-design, escalation paths, and human routes. The standing International AI Safety Report 2026 (Bengio-led) likewise flags companion apps fostering psychological dependence. ACCESSIBILITY: no change to SageReasoning's target — WCAG 2.1 / 2.2 AA remains the live legal standard (ADA Title II, Section 508, EU Accessibility Act); WCAG 3.0 is still a Working Draft (refreshed Mar 2026; next draft ~Sept 2026; W3C Recommendation not expected until ~late 2029). Section 504 healthcare federal-funding accessibility deadline (11 May 2026) and ADA Title II state/local deadline (24 Apr 2026) have now passed. RISK — FOUNDER ATTENTION: rising disclosure + crisis-referral compliance floor for human-facing tools. OPPORTUNITY: the honest-positioning posture (R18a/R19) aligns with both rising public concern and the New York template.
